{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Group by channel and compute average revenue per order
grouped = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)

# Extract values
df_result = grouped.reset_index()
df_result.columns = ['channel', 'avg_revenue']

print('Average revenue per completed order by channel:')
print(df_result)

# Compute the difference
diff = df_result[df_result['channel'] == 'email']['avg_revenue'].iloc[0] - \
       df_result[df_result['channel'] == 'paid_search']['avg_revenue'].iloc[0]

print(f'Email channel average revenue: {df_result[df_result["channel"] == "email"]["avg_revenue"].iloc[0]} USD')
print(f'Paid_search channel average revenue: {df_result[df_result["channel"] == "paid_search"]["avg_revenue"].iloc[0]} USD')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.2f} USD')"}
